integrity.proof_scope: All integers n>=6; all allowable excluded edges by relabeling.
integrity.scientific_claim: Two positive centered Walsh Gram eigenvalues, exact sector multiplicities, n-dimensional nullspace and sharp squared frame condition number.
integrity.verification: Exact rational enumeration for n=6,7,8,9, corroborating an all-parameter combinatorial proof.

limitations: Centered first-order edge Walsh characters only; not the uncentered constant-plus-edge Gram.
Uniform undirected Hamiltonian tours with exactly one forbidden edge and n>=6; no extension to weighted laws or multiple excluded edges.
Historical priority has residual risk from older tour-polytope incidence-covariance calculations; no independent mathematical audit.
title: Two-level first-Fourier stability of Hamiltonian tours avoiding one edge
